title: Mould Tool Inspection System
subtitle: An advanced vision-based solution designed to ensure mould cavities are correctly filled and free from defects before the production cycle continues. Built for speed, accuracy, and reliability in demanding manufacturing environments.

sections.title: Key Features
features: Component Presence Verification – Confirms each mould cycle contains the required part before proceeding
Defect & Residue Detection – Identifies broken parts and leftover runners in the cavity to prevent defective production
Single-Click Training – Fast setup with minimal user input for quick deployment
24/7 Operational Capability – Designed for continuous, around-the-clock production environments
Optimised Lighting for Reflective Surfaces – Advanced imaging overcomes challenges with shiny or polished moulds
Fail-Proof Detection – Minimises false negatives and process errors for maximum reliability
Damage & Downtime Prevention – Early detection helps avoid costly mould repairs and reduces production delays

title: Capsule Roundness Tester
subtitle: An advanced optical inspection system for testing flavour capsules used in cigarettes on a sampling basis, ensuring dimensional accuracy and quality.

sections.title: Capabilities
features: Can measure up to 20 capsules in a single instance
Measures up to 20 capsules in a single instance
Compatible with capsules of various colours.

sections.title: Parameters measured:
features: Roundness
Minimum & Maximum Diameter
Mean & Standard Deviation
Wall Thickness & Air Bubbles (for wet capsules)
Compatible with various capsule colours
Data Analysis & Report Logging – Integrated database and reporting interface
Complete Parameter Control – Job configuration for multiple capsule sizes

title: Label Inspection System
subtitle: A 100% web inspection solution for high-speed printing and labelling quality assurance across various printing technologies.

sections.title: Defects Detected:
features: Missing characters/logo print errors
Soiling, splashes, smears
Missing labels or an unremoved matrix
Die-cutting misalignment
Colour variations (>20%)
Damage & holes
Label wrinkling

sections.title: Key Features:
features: Inspection area: 50mm – 400mm
Speed: Up to 150 meters/min
Supports both area scan and line scan cameras
Supports: Roll-to-roll printing, Discrete carton printing, Sheet-form printing, Screen printing, Flexo, CTP Plate, and Rotogravure technologies
Data Loging and Report generation

title: Advanced PCT Inspection System
subtitle: A next-generation solution for ultra-fast and accurate PCT inspection, engineered for speed, precision, and reliability in cigarette manufacturing.

sections.title: Defects Detected:
sections.description: Proprietary image processing algorithms ensure accurate inspection even at maximum speed.
features: Wander
Skewness
Width Check
Torn PCT
Flagging

sections.title: Key Features:
features: Ultra High-Speed Performance – Handles up to 12,000 units per minute.
Versatile PCT Type Support – White on White, Brown on White, Black on White.
Quick Configuration – Set up in under 5 minutes.
Universal Mounting System – Flexible installation in production lines.
Interactive Real-Time GUI – Modify inspection parameters with an intuitive interface.
NG Image Logging – Stores defective images for up to 3 months for quality review.
SAP Integration Ready – Enables seamless data exchange and production analytics.
Beckhoff Industrial IPC – Rugged, reliable industrial-grade computing for 24/7 operation.

title: Online Wet Capsule Inspection System
subtitle: An advanced vision-based inspection solution using deep learning and hybrid image analysis to detect capsule formation defects during production. Reduces manual inspection, improves consistency, and prevents defective products from reaching the market

sections.title: Various Defects Detected
features: Satellite / Tail Formation
Oversized or Undersized Capsules
Oval Capsules
Double Capsules
Air Bubbles
Irregular Shapes
Eccentricity

sections.title: Key Features
features: High-Precision Camera – Detects defects as small as 80 microns.
Hybrid AI Algorithm – Ensures accurate defect classification.
Interactive GUI – Adjust inspection settings easily.
User-Friendly Setup – Configure and switch jobs quickly.
Daily Report Generation – Automated quality reporting for production analysis.
